train_detector: run the detectron2 training script with --data-dir, --dataset-name, and --annotations-json arguments to train a Locobot object detector
eval_detector: run the training script with --eval-only flag to evaluate a trained Locobot detector model on validation data
setup_dataset: register train and val datasets with DatasetCatalog using pickle property files and a JSON annotations file
build_train_loader: build a detection training data loader using LocobotDatasetMapper for custom property-aware object detection
get_dataset_dicts: fetch and construct dataset dictionaries from botcapture image files and JSON annotations for a given train or val split
